Trump Bans Media Outlets, Makes Greenland Vow

President Trump has banned several media outlets, with one report stating this action does not violate the U.S. Constitution, according to Senator John Barrasso. However, Senator Cory Booker claimed Trump has "no regard" for the First Amendment following the White House media bans. Separately, Trump made a vow concerning Greenland. The coverage also includes commentary on Trump's disruption of national parks and questions about his grasp on reality and American exceptionalism.
